testcase.name: keepalives resume for the next request after terminal response delivery()
keepalives emitted during assertion processing stop before terminal response fragments()
assertion with UV rejection returns CTAP2_ERR_OPERATION_DENIED()
keepalive cadence continues through processing and user presence then stops before response()
successful assertion returns CTAP2_OK and fragmented CBOR response in FIFO order()
fragmented MakeCredential corpus preserves request and attestation response bytes()
